Native gold ore only spawns in the nether, and its not common. What is far more common is precious metal ore, and if you want to get gold in any appreciable amount, you're going to need to use precious metal. As such, this next quest chain is the processing line for §eturning Precious Metal Ore into Gold Dust!§f
§fFirst, we'll need that precious metal in a good dust form (You'll need 36), and some Aqua Regia, a combination of Nitric Acid and Hydrochloric Acid
